background.usage: The page: screens, the app bar, the bottom bar, the rail, sheets.

foreground.usage: Primary text and glyphs on background, card and muted.

primary.usage: The one primary action per decision, a selected control, accent text and glyphs.

secondary.usage: The secondary button, the stepper steps, a pressed row.

muted.usage: Recessed grounds: the search field, tracks, skeleton bars, the segmented tray.

muted-foreground.usage: Secondary text, hints, captions and resting glyphs.

destructive.usage: The destructive button's label over its soft tint.

destructive-foreground.usage: Text on a solid destructive fill.

error.usage: Error text, an invalid field's edge, the danger tint's edge.

error-foreground.usage: Text on a solid error fill.

card.usage: Cards and the rows that are cards.

border.usage: Every hairline: card and field edges, dividers, the app bar once content scrolls under it.

barrier.usage: The scrim behind dialogs and bottom sheets.

success.usage: Success text and glyphs: a right answer, mastery.

success-fill.usage: The mastery fill of the progress bar and the donut.

warning.usage: Warning text and glyphs: a refusal or a limit, nothing lost.

warning-fill.usage: The warning button and the learning fill.

info.usage: Information text and the deck glyph.

info-fill.usage: The information fill of a badge.

figure.purpose: Key numbers that replace a sentence, in tabular figures.

term.purpose: The word being studied on a flashcard.

term-compact.purpose: A word inside a match tile, a dialog title.

screen-title.purpose: Screen and section headings, the app bar title.

item-title.purpose: List and settings rows, sheet titles.

content.purpose: A card's meaning, a study passage, the text typed in a field.

caption.purpose: A field's message and counter, a tile's meaning, captions.

label.purpose: Field labels, chips, metadata, the search field.

shadows.name: shadow-raised
shadows.purpose: ForUI shadow under the surfaces that float over the scroll: the FAB and the floating notice. Cards stay flat.

narrative.overview: MemoX should feel like a quiet, focused study space. It is drawn with ForUI in a light and a dark palette built from one theme in lib/core/theme (ADR-026): a calm neutral page, cards with a hairline edge, and one accent that means "act". Component philosophy: "Calm and exact".
keyCharacteristics: One sans family (Be Vietnam Pro, with Noto Sans KR for Korean), twelve text roles on ForUI's type scale.
Neutral grounds: background for the page, card for cards, muted for recessed grounds, each edge a border hairline.
One accent: primary for the primary fill, the selected control and accent text, with a value per mode.
Phone first, context.screenMargin at the screen edge, sizeControl touch targets everywhere.
Every text and edge pair of both palettes is contrast-tested, with no exception list.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent means "act". A primary fill appears once per decision; the rest of the screen is neutral.

rules.name: The Green Means Progress Rule
rules.body: Green is status.success or status.successFill and nothing else; green is never decoration.

rules.name: The Text Colour Rule
rules.body: Text and glyphs read a text role (foreground, mutedForeground, primary, a status colour, error, a …Foreground role), never a fill.

rules.name: The Tint Rule
rules.body: A tinted ground is a role tinted over the surface directly beneath it, color.tintOver(MxTintBase.of(context)).

rules.name: The Mode Rule
rules.body: A widget never chooses a colour or a size by brightness; a colour that differs by mode is a palette role the two palettes already differ on.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Text holds 4.5:1 and non-text 3:1 in both palettes; a failing pair is a palette change, never an exception.

rules.name: The Twelve Roles Rule
rules.body: Screens use the twelve MxTextRoles; a role changes only its colour or switches to the mono face.

rules.name: The Text Grows Rule
rules.body: Text scale is never clamped and no fixed height wraps text.

rules.name: The Touch Floor Rule
rules.body: Painted size never sets the touch area; every control keeps a sizeControl square hit area.

rules.name: The Footer Pair Rule
rules.body: Two footer actions share the row while both labels fit; otherwise they stack full width.

rules.name: The Hairline Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Group with a ground and a hairline first; a surface that does not float never casts a shadow.

dos: Do take every value from the ForUI theme through context.colors, status, texts, dimens, radii and hairline.
Do use primary for exactly one primary action per decision.
Do keep the contrast test green; a failing pair is a palette change.
Do guarantee a sizeControl touch area on every interactive element, and let text containers grow.
Do write failure copy in the local-first voice: say first that nothing was lost, then offer the retry.
Do use the spacing scale and context.screenMargin rather than ad-hoc values.
donts: Don't write a hex code, a size or a duration in a widget, a test or a document; name the role.
Don't import package:forui or a Material component in a feature; extend an Mx widget.
Don't open a dialog, a sheet or a toast except through the Mx adapters.
Don't use a fill as text; use its text role.
Don't branch on brightness in a widget or lay a colour over a ground at an alpha.
Don't restyle a text role beyond its colour or the mono face.
Don't declare a removed theme name again in any form.
